UserProfile.title: User Profile
UserProfile.description: Stores user-specific vault preferences and metadata. Encrypted at rest.

WalletAsset.title: Wallet Asset
WalletAsset.description: Non-custodial cryptocurrency asset key. Strictly isolated to the authenticated owner via hardware-level security rules.

privateKey.description: Owner-encrypted private key for on-device signing only.

Transaction.title: Transaction
Transaction.description: Immutable ledger record of financial activity. Verified by decentralized node consensus.

/users/{userId}.description: User profile document. Primary owner identity for all vault sub-collections. Must exist before sub-documents can be provisioned.

/users/{userId}/assets/{assetId}.description: Isolated cryptographic keys. Strictly owner-access only. The 'primary-vault' document ID is used for deterministic root identity.

/users/{userId}/transactions/{txId}.description: User's immutable transaction ledger for all vault activities.
